# Engine APIs

## JavaScript API {#api}

0.2 replaces the one large 0.1 package API with the functions of the `carve-js` package root, and each stage (parse, resolve, render) has its own call.

Move `carveToHtml` callers to `render`, and consumers of old report objects to `renderWithDiagnostics`. `parse` returns a resolved 2.0 tree, and `parseWithDiagnostics` also returns findings; no separate public `resolve` call exists. `render` accepts source or a 2.0 tree for HTML. Pass only 0.2 options. Compare site CSS and scripts against the 0.2 section, list and table HTML.

The full replacement table is in JavaScript API; HTML and selector changes are in HTML and page selectors, and Markdown import in Markdown import is GFM import.

## PHP API {#api-php}

0.2 replaces 0.1 in the same Composer package and namespace, `MarkupCarve\Carve`, and the 0.1 classes are gone. The configured `CarveConverter` object gives way to static calls on `MarkupCarve\Carve\Carve` that each take one validated options array.

Move `$converter->convert($source)` to `Carve::render($source, $options)` and keep the options array where you kept the converter. The command line stays `vendor/bin/carve` with the 0.2 commands. The call-by-call table is [Moving a PHP host from Carve 0.1 to 0.2](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve-php/blob/main/docs/migration.md) in carve-php; the summary is in PHP API.

## Rust API {#api-rust}

The `carve` crate drops its 0.1 engine, and the 0.2 calls live in `carve::api`. The 0.2 `carve` command replaces the 0.1 one.

Move `to_html` to `api::render`, `parse` to `api::parse`, `to_json` to `api::parse` then `api::encode_tree`, and `carve::Options::new()` to `api::Options::default()`. Some calls have no 0.2 counterpart, such as `merge_ast` and `decision_trace`. The call-by-call table is [Migrating from 0.1](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve-rs/blob/main/README.md#migrating-from-01) in the carve-rs README; the summary is in Rust API.

**Specification (external):** [JavaScript API](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/blob/main/spec/0.2/UPGRADING.md#javascript-api); [HTML and page selectors](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/blob/main/spec/0.2/UPGRADING.md#html-and-page-selectors); [Markdown import is GFM import](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/blob/main/spec/0.2/UPGRADING.md#markdown-import-is-gfm-import); [PHP API](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/blob/main/spec/0.2/UPGRADING.md#php-api); [Rust API](https://github.com/markup-carve/carve/blob/main/spec/0.2/UPGRADING.md#rust-api).
